atlas_fit.current_problem: Atlas needs reproducible, evidence-first agent workflows that distinguish trusted reproduction from exploratory modification.
atlas_fit.future_risk: Research agents may chase scores, silently change semantics, or mix exploratory artifacts with accepted evidence.

claims.claim: The repository documents trusted and exploration lanes, reproducibility outputs, auditable changes, and explicit authorization before candidate exploration.
Its skills have been independently proven across all Atlas environments.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence

unresolved: Runtime behavior, security effectiveness, performance, and compatibility were not independently executed or benchmarked in this Mission.
